Definition: Jabneel, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: The border went out unto the side of Ekron northward, and the border was drawn to Shicron, and passed along to mount Baalah, and went out unto Jabneel. The coast of Naphtali ran from Heleph unto Jabneel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Jabneels show how the land was measured: one on Judah's northern border and one in Naphtali, and the same name marks two ends of the inheritance.
